routes.label: Skyline Runner

requiredBeforePublic: select or certify a platformer world asset with mesh-derived playable surfaces
prove character foot contact is visibly bound to retained platform surface evidence
prove character/world scale and camera framing from the current retained screenshot
pass public platformer visual review from the current retained screenshot
evidence: aura3d-game-examples-stop-decision.md records the NO decision for current engine APIs and asset catalog
tests/reports/showcase-spec-compiler/skyline-runner/game-template/showcase-skyline-runner-platformer-playable-surfaces.json retains hash-bound but non-public-quality playable-surface evidence
tests/fixtures/showcase-spec/skyline-runner.json records failing platformer asset-pair evidence for the current screenshot
docs/project/showcase-visual-review.json blocks public platformer visual approval

gameAssetPairEvidence.notes: Current retained screenshots prove the typed character and side-scroller world render, but they still do not visually prove a public-quality character-to-world game presentation. Public status stays blocked until primary foreground size, character scale, foot contact, camera framing, and level flow visibly bind to the world geometry.

routes.deployCheckCommand: pnpm exec tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.base.json packages/aura3d-cli/src/cli.ts check-deploy --dist apps/showcase-skyline-runner/dist --release --source apps/showcase-skyline-runner/src --asset showcaseWalkAnimatedGirl --asset showcaseSideScrollerWorld

evidence: aura3d-game-examples-stop-decision.md records the NO decision for current engine APIs and asset catalog
